name: dot1dPortGarpTable
description: A table of GARP control information about every bridge port. This is indexed by dot1dBasePort.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.1.4.1.1.name: dot1dBasePort
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.1.4.1.1.description: The port number of the port for which this entry contains bridge management information.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.6.1.3.1.1.1.name: dot1dPortGarpJoinTime
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.6.1.3.1.1.1.description: The GARP Join time, in centiseconds. The value of this object MUST be retained across reinitializations of the management system.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.6.1.3.1.1.2.name: dot1dPortGarpLeaveTime
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.6.1.3.1.1.2.description: The GARP Leave time, in centiseconds. The value of this object MUST be retained across reinitializations of the management system.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.6.1.3.1.1.3.name: dot1dPortGarpLeaveAllTime
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.6.1.3.1.1.3.description: The GARP LeaveAll time, in centiseconds. The value of this object MUST be retained across reinitializations of the management system.
